clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Satyr Horns draw dryads seeking vengeance and traders bound for Ratchet. The horns come from satyrs whose corruption has taken root in the ancient forest.

Ashenvale’s satyrs bear horns that mark their demonic corruption. At the Shrine of Aessina, the dryad Illiyana gathers them in grief and vengeance for her lost sister Anilia. Pixel, a traveling goblin resting at Splintertree Post, seeks them for trade. Demand for satyr horns has risen in Ratchet, where hunters can sell these remnants of slain demons.

Satyr Horns must be cut from the beasts themselves; ordinary suppliers do not sell them. Satyrs hold strongholds across Ashenvale, including the corrupted groves of Xavian, the hollows of Satyrnaar, and the ruins of Night Run. Clearing these enclaves drives back the lingering demonic taint and supplies grieving guardians and eager merchants with proof of the cull.
